summary: Frontend-only test of iteration 7 (backend not retested). Overall 8 of 10 frontend checks pass. (1) Landing catch bar: lp-catch-ticker was NOT RENDERED at all. The <CatchTicker catches={catches}/> line had been deleted from Landing() in the last commit, leaving the component as dead code. I restored the one line. After that, at 1920 and 390 the bar is static: a full-width 40px strip with no translate transform; only the fr-fade animation runs on the span. lp-catch-current alternates between the 2 API catches about every 4s. No horizontal overflow. (2) Branding: the logo, About section and Seo say Fishing Realms. But document.title is 'Fishing Realm · Fantasy Fishing MMO' (singular), and so is the meta description in public/index.html. A news post body (DB data) still says 'Halloween comes to The Fishing Lands!'. (3) Mobile modal scroll (Modal.js grid-rows fix): works. Wheel scroll reaches max scrollTop on waters (4200/4200, last card water-card-cinder reachable), shop, journal and profile; inventory has no overflow. Real touch drags via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent with an is_mobile/has_touch context scrolled the Travel Map (scrollTop 1455 after 3 swipes). synthesizeScrollGesture does nothing in this headless environment, even on the landing page, so ignore it. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). (4) Glass theme: fr-modal uses a linear-gradient of rgba(14,13,12,.82) to rgba(5,5,5,.92), backdrop blur 18px, a 1px rgba(214,172,92,.42) gold border and 6px radius on desktop. It is square and full-screen on mobile. It looks good. modal-close-btn closes both page-modal (back to /game) and more-modal. (5) Fishing: SAIL opens /game/waters, Travel to Millbrook enters water mode, and walking to fish-1 sets atSpot. cast-fish-button opens fight-panel. The tension-frame gradient is red, orange, yellow, green (zone), yellow, orange, red: green in the zone with warm colours on both sides. A hold/release controller using Space kept it PERFECT, the fight resolved and the catch-popup showed (Pumpkinseed, NEW SPECIES), Keep worked. No JS errors. (6) Harbour: Pearl Shop signpost tap now walks straight there (1700 to 1464 in about 5s, no ping-pong) and auto-opens /game/pearl-shop. The iteration-6 bug is FIXED. Tackle Shop tap auto-opens /game/shop, and closing it does not re-open it. 20s idle in the harbour plus 3 harbour/water switches: 0 page errors and 0 console errors. There is one PixiJS v8 deprecation warning ('addChild: Only Containers will be allowed to add children') from buildScene. (7) MOBILE HUD STILL BROKEN (carried over from iteration 6, unfixed): at 390x844 the action-bar is 652px wide inside a 527px scaled HUD. menu-waters spans x=-37..29 (clipped) and menu-more spans x=390..427, fully off-screen, so a phone user cannot open the More menu at all. Tapping (388,810) did nothing. When force-clicked, the overflow-hidden game-page container scrolls sideways and the More modal renders shifted left and clipped.

ui_bugs.issue: The component existed but was never rendered: <CatchTicker catches={catches}/> was removed from Landing() in the last commit. I restored the line after <Motes />, and it now works as specified.

ui_bugs.component: Game HUD action-bar on mobile 390x844 (World.js L150-158)
ui_bugs.issue: The bar is 652px wide while the HUD is w/s≈527px. menu-more is entirely off-screen (x 390..427) and menu-waters is clipped (x -37..29), so More (Quests, Market, Log out and more) cannot be reached on a phone. When focus or scroll-into-view happens, the overflow-hidden game-page scrolls horizontally and modals render shifted and clipped. Fix: shrink the Ring size, gap and fish-btn width under about 600px (e.g. size 30, gap-1, fish-btn 64px), or let the bar wrap or scroll.
<title> is 'Fishing Realm · Fantasy Fishing MMO' and the meta description says 'Fishing Realm —'. Both should be 'Fishing Realms'.

integration_issues.issue: A news post (DB content) still says 'Halloween comes to The Fishing Lands!'. Update the seeded or news data.

issues: The title banner uses sm:-mt-7, so titles such as 'MENU' and 'PEARL SHOP' sit on the top gold border line and look cut by it. Either centre the title inside the header or give it a solid glass plate.
The 'Tap to walk…' hint pill still overlaps the Tournaments signpost label
The 'Tackle Shop [E]' spot-prompt covers the Pearl Shop label
On arrival the hero stands on top of the signpost icon and hides its label
Other players' sprites cover the 'Sea Serpent · Travel' label
The idle reel-button ('Hold to reel (or Space)') is nearly transparent and low-contrast over the water; it only gets a background while held
The sweet spot drifts, so when the zone sits at around 70% the right side shows only a thin yellow/orange band. That is fine for gameplay, but the static 'centre' look only holds at the start
It shows '6 g' value but the button says 'Sell 4 g'. If the vendor rate is intended, label it (e.g. 'value 6g · vendor 4g')
The durability labels '100/100' under the equipped rod/reel/line slots overlap the neighbouring slot at 390px

Confirm the restored <CatchTicker catches={catches}/> in Landing.js is intended (the review request says the bar is replaced by a crossfading line)
Rename <title> and the meta description in public/index.html to 'Fishing Realms'; update the news post that says 'The Fishing Lands'
Polish: modal title banner overlapping the top border; reel-button idle contrast; harbour label overlaps (hint pill, spot-prompt, hero over signposts)
Fix the PixiJS v8 deprecation: addChild is called on a non-Container (Sprite/Graphics) in buildScene/makeLife
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js: the CatchTicker definition remained while its usage was deleted. Watch for dead components after refactors.
World.js: the action-bar size depends only on `w < 600 ? 36 : 46` for the rings, while the 92px fish-btn and gap-2.5 stay fixed, so the bar cannot fit narrow screens
Modal.js Escape handler: document.querySelector('.fixed.inset-0.z-50').click() relies on class names to find nested overlays. This is fragile; use a modal stack in the store
Landing.js CatchTicker: FISH_ART[c.species_id % 10] still maps art arbitrarily, so the fish image does not match the named species (e.g. the Feral Goldfish shows a red fish icon)

success_rate.frontend: 80% (8/10 checks pass after the ticker fix; mobile HUD and title branding fail)

seed_data_creation: None. TestAngler caught one Pumpkinseed (kept) at Millbrook and travelled there. TestAngler2's look was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request.post('/api/auth/login') and set localStorage owo_token. Mode is held in sessionStorage fr_mode ('harbour'/'water'); /game/fish switches to water mode. Walk with window.__fx.dest={x:545,y:508} for fish-1, then dispatch pointerdown on cast-fish-button. You can autoplay the fight by dispatching window KeyboardEvent Space keydown/keyup by comparing the tension-needle style.left with the tension-zone-box centre. Pearl Shop: click (636,716) at 1920x1080 from spawn. Tackle Shop: click (593,555). For mobile touch scrolling use a new context with has_touch/is_mobile and CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent; synthesizeScrollGesture does not work here.
rca of the issue: Missing ticker: the last commit replaced the marquee markup inside CatchTicker but also deleted its JSX usage in Landing(). Mobile HUD: the action-bar width is 6 rings (36px plus labels) + a 92px fish-btn + gaps ≈ 652px, which exceeds the scaled HUD width w/s (527 at 390px), and the bar is centred with -translate-x-1/2, so it overflows both edges. The game-page container (overflow-hidden) becomes 437px scrollable, and programmatic scroll or focus shifts all overlays.
